commands.title: Lock Screen
commands.subtitle: Locks the screen; your session stays on

commands.title: Log Out
commands.subtitle: Ends your session, asking first; applications are not forced closed

commands.title: Restart
commands.subtitle: Restarts Windows, asking first; applications are forced closed

commands.title: Shut Down
commands.subtitle: Powers Windows off, asking first; applications are forced closed

commands.title: Sleep
commands.subtitle: Sleeps the computer; a Modern Standby one sleeps by its displays turning off

commands.title: Hibernate
commands.subtitle: Hibernates the computer, or says that it cannot

commands.title: Turn Off Displays
commands.subtitle: Turns the displays off

commands.title: Start Screen Saver
commands.subtitle: Starts the screen saver, or says that none is set

commands.title: Volume Up
commands.subtitle: Raises the volume by the step Windows' volume keys take

commands.title: Volume Down
commands.subtitle: Lowers the volume by the same step

commands.title: Toggle Mute
commands.subtitle: Mutes the sound, or unmutes it, saying the volume it ended at

commands.title: Set Volume
commands.subtitle: Sets the volume to a level from 0 to 100

commands.title: Toggle Microphone Mute
commands.subtitle: Mutes every microphone when any is on, unmutes them all otherwise

commands.title: Open Recycle Bin
commands.subtitle: Opens the Recycle Bin in File Explorer

commands.title: Empty Recycle Bin
commands.subtitle: Empties the Recycle Bin, asking first; an already empty one is a success

commands.title: Toggle System Appearance
commands.subtitle: Switches Windows between light and dark, saying which it chose

commands.title: Toggle HDR
commands.subtitle: Turns HDR on when any capable display is off, otherwise off

commands.title: Show Desktop
commands.subtitle: Hides the open windows, or brings them back, as the shell's own toggle

commands.title: Toggle Hidden Files
commands.subtitle: Shows hidden files in File Explorer, or hides them again

commands.title: Eject Removable Drives
commands.subtitle: Ejects every removable drive, reporting each drive that refused

commands.title: Toggle Bluetooth
commands.subtitle: Turns Bluetooth on when any radio is off, otherwise off
